_doc: Crash/resume file for the 15-min paid check-in loop (Het, 2026-08-26: 'use it every 15 mins... make sure if you are not left tokens you have a crash file to store what you did before the limit so you can start working again as session resets'). Every firing reads this FIRST. status='idle' means the previous firing finished cleanly or found nothing to do -- start fresh. status='in_progress' means a previous firing got cut off mid-task -- resume from resume_instructions EXACTLY, don't restart from scratch and don't second-guess what's already been committed. Update and push this file at the START of any multi-step task (before doing the risky part) and again when finishing or safely stopping -- see next_session.md and the Routine's own prompt for the full protocol.
